verdict.rationale: Bolt.new generates full-stack apps from a prompt, running Node servers, npm tools, and integrating backend services like Supabase for database/auth, alongside frontend UI generation from a single prompt/design. However, backend logic relies on outsourced third-party services (Supabase) rather than native custom backend code, and community feedback notes this limits the depth of backend logic achievable and cites reliability issues (doom loops, breakage) when building complex full-stack apps.
